Provides a resource to create a teo security policy

> **NOTE:** If the user's EO version is the personal version, `managedRuleGroups` needs to set one; If the user's EO version is a non personal version, `managedRuleGroups` needs to set 17. If the user does not set the `managedRuleGroups` parameter, the system will generate it by default.

## Example Usage

### If entity is ZoneDefaultPolicy

    </dt>
    <dd>Execution actions for custom rules. the Name parameter value of SecurityAction supports: <!-- raw HTML omitted -->Deny: block;<!-- raw HTML omitted --> <!-- raw HTML omitted -->Monitor: observe;<!-- raw HTML omitted --> <!-- raw HTML omitted -->ReturnCustomPage: block using a specified page;<!-- raw HTML omitted --> <!-- raw HTML omitted -->Redirect: Redirect to URL;<!-- raw HTML omitted --> <!-- raw HTML omitted -->BlockIP: IP blocking;<!-- raw HTML omitted --> <!-- raw HTML omitted -->JSChallenge: JavaScript challenge;<!-- raw HTML omitted --> <!-- raw HTML omitted -->ManagedChallenge: managed challenge;<!-- raw HTML omitted --> <!-- raw HTML omitted -->Allow: Allow.<!-- raw HTML omitted -->.</dd><dt class="property-required"

For example: <!-- raw HTML omitted -->${key} in ['x-trace-id']: parameter name is equal to x-trace-id. <!-- raw HTML omitted -->.<!-- raw HTML omitted -->${key} in ['x-trace-id'] and ${value} like ['Bearer *']: parameter name is equal to x-trace-id and the parameter value wildcard matches Bearer *. <!-- raw HTML omitted -->.</dd><dt class="property-required"

## Import



teo security policy can be imported using the id, e.g.

If entity is ZoneDefaultPolicy

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Teo/securityPolicyConfig:SecurityPolicyConfig example zone-37u62pwxfo8s#ZoneDefaultPolicy
```

If entity is Host

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Teo/securityPolicyConfig:SecurityPolicyConfig example zone-37u62pwxfo8s#Host#www.example.com
```

If entity is Template

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Teo/securityPolicyConfig:SecurityPolicyConfig example zone-37u62pwxfo8s#Template#temp-05dtxkyw
```



To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
